author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). Handler-clause laundering: a def declared pure handles Reader, and the ask CLAUSE performs Console I/O. Handler typing strips the handled effect from the body but the clauses' own effects must surface in the result row. Effect rows stage 3b infers clause bodies and unions their rows into the handle expression's ambient (the section 7 rule), so the undeclared clause effect dies at the def boundary (CDX2031, with CDX2033 at the let binding). This test is the enforcement's regression guard.
